_comment_cors: Browser origins allowed to call this service (ChoCors). Empty: Portal:BaseUrl if set, otherwise none outside Development. Name each origin (https://host[:port]); "*" is refused outside Development; credentials are never allowed.

SmartAuth._comment_external_login: Production member/provider sign-in through Microsoft Entra External ID (OIDC, code flow + PKCE). Disabled until the External ID tenant exists. When Enabled, Authority, ClientId, ClientSecret, ExpectedIssuer and DisplayName are required (startup fails otherwise) and Authority/ExpectedIssuer must be HTTPS outside Development. ClientSecret comes from Key Vault secret SmartAuth--ExternalLogin--ClientSecret, never from this file. The IdP redirect URI is {SmartAuth:Issuer}{CallbackPath}. See docs/security/smart-auth-tenancy.md.
SmartAuth._comment_certificates: Token signing and encryption certificates (PKCS#12, RSA >= 2048) as SmartAuth:SigningCertificates:N:Pfx / SmartAuth:EncryptionCertificates:N:Pfx (base64, from Key Vault certificates named SmartAuth--SigningCertificates--N--Pfx etc.) or :N:Path; optional :N:Password and :N:Standby. Required outside Development/Testing; the first entry not in Standby is used, every signing certificate is published in the JWKS. See docs/security/smart-auth-tenancy.md (Token signing keys).
